I saved Ilse's note as a private memory: their Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. The note says it came from their DM and should only come up in conversations with Ilse. I added a line for it to the memory index and replied to them in the DM to confirm. As they asked, I took no other action.

One thing to check: today is 14 October, so a 7 July cutoff has either passed or means next July. I didn't ask Ilse which, since they said no action was needed.
